intro: You Have Served Us Well is a warlock quest in Stormwind City. Undertaken on behalf of Zardeth of the Black Claw, warlock practitioners report back to the cabal beneath the Slaughtered Lamb to finalize their service and claim their reward.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I hear Lord Wishock enjoyed his beverage.

You have served us well, friend. The Warlocks of Stormwind will be able to practice our ways without disturbance, thanks to you. For your efforts, I have prepared a special gift for you. Speak with my servant, Zggi, and claim your reward.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Master says give gift to friend. Zggi wants to keep nice gift but Zggi knows better than to betray Master.
